about.en: Artificial Inu (AI) is a community memecoin launched through the LONG launchpad on Robinhood Chain, at 0x2E8c31162b855A2ffa90F6F8634643Ad6F111e18 with a 1,000,000,000 supply. Its main pool pairs AI with Robinhood's tokenized NVDA stock token; trading fees in NVDA go to a community vault and fees in AI are burned or locked. It does not represent NVIDIA equity or any redemption right.
